snippet.title: Secrets of the Burrow: Vixoria's Quest - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3729660/Secrets_of_the_Burrow_Vixorias_Quest/
Wishlist on Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/secrets-of-the-burrow-vixorias-quest-4f45a1

🐾 Secrets of the Burrow: Vixoria’s Quest  
An action-adventure 3D platformer full of gliding, puzzles, and charming animal characters, inspired by classics.

This cute and story-rich indie game blends cinematic storytelling, exploration, and light puzzle elements, developed in Unreal Engine 5 by Foxboy Productions.

🔗 Learn more & follow:  
https://bio.site/fbp
